name: nitin-claude-mods
description: Animated backdrop themes and side panels (Session Diary, Security Watch, Mission Scroll, Quick Actions) for Claude Code.

plugins.name: wisteria-moon
plugins.description: A Taisho-era night behind the Claude Code Desktop chat: wisteria sways over a moonlit river while Claude works, and arcs of water and flame sweep around the moon when it needs you. Desktop app only.

plugins.name: grand-tide
plugins.description: A galleon at sunset behind the Claude Code Desktop chat: the ship rides the swell while Claude works, and a treasure map unrolls with a route to a glowing X when it needs you. Desktop app only.

plugins.name: shinobi-dusk
plugins.description: A ninja village at dusk behind the Claude Code Desktop chat: leaves fall while Claude works, and a seal ignites with a whirl of leaves when it needs you. Desktop app only.

plugins.name: session-diary
plugins.description: A side panel with a live timeline of everything Claude does this session: commands, edits, reads and searches, with timestamps, durations, +/- line counts and failures in red.

plugins.name: security-watch
plugins.description: A side panel that flags risky tool calls as they happen: destructive commands, force-pushes, scripts piped from the internet, secrets in files, edits outside the project, installs and network use. It only watches, never blocks.

plugins.name: mission-scroll
plugins.description: A ninja-style mission log in a side panel: every prompt is a mission ranked D to S by the work it took, flawless missions earn a star, and your shinobi rank grows as you complete them.

plugins.name: quick-actions
plugins.description: A side panel of one-click buttons that send common requests to Claude: run tests, review changes, lint, commit, explain the last error, undo the last edit, summarize. Save your own prompts as buttons too.
